cpu_repeat_rule: Only one specific recorded failed CPU contract repair; no passed-suite repeat

common.head: subset65536
common.cache: Natural inherited page cache; exact 8K predecessor for both 200K captures; no drop/affinity/power changes
common.collector: Pinned Nsight2026.5.1; unchanged synchronous repeat:1:sync, trace cuda,nvtx; no preload or custom CUPTI subscriber

acceptance.scope: Only recorded GPU kernel/copy/memset execution and correlated CPU/API phase comparison. Full trace integrity and performance acceptance remain separate and unproved.
acceptance.warning_policy: Keep strict diagnostics unchanged. Only exact existing target generic CUDA/NVTX warning pair may support limited comparison with per-capture actual finish/normal-exit evidence and terminal-filter mechanism review. All other warnings/loss/API/ownership failures stop.
acceptance.memory_policy: Unmatched cudaMemsetAsync records stay PARAMETERS_UNOBSERVED_IN_THIS_CAPTURE. Never fill from another process or infer zero by count. Unexplained copy/other memory absence stops.
acceptance.cpu_policy: Wall-threadCPU is nonrunning wall, not GPU wait; host synchronize durations are not device busy. No parent-child double count; retain phase GPU unions and signature counts.

stop_conditions: Environment/monitor/forced or failed own cleanup => ENV_ABORT, stop own processes only
Output/work-contract/launch-kernel/PID/NVTX mismatch or explicit loss/overflow or new warning => stop; preserve incomplete data
No extra normal HTTP, fixture, parameter ledger, versions or settings to obtain a passing result
If complete pairs do not identify a cause, record attribution insufficient; do not auto-expand
reuse: Unchanged fixed fixture/negative controls, actual8K parameter mechanism and normal two-head repeat/correctness/quality evidence by exact identity; no historical trace promotion
